answer.reason: Two events belong to the land itself: Abram's departure from it, and the word of the LORD coming to Ezekiel there; the verses about the Chaldean army and wise men concern the people.

clauses.english: was the land Abram came out of before he dwelt in Charran
clauses.quote: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans

clauses.english: was where the word of the LORD came to Ezekiel among the captives
clauses.quote: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest

doubts: Most marked verses speak of the Chaldeans as a people or army (besieging Jerusalem, wise men, prophecies against Babylon), not of the land, so they were left out.
The Ur of the Chaldees verses (GEN 11:28, 11:31, 15:7, NEH 9:7) name the city Ur rather than the region, so they were not cited.
